tables.name: files
tables.label: Files
tables.description: A library of note files. Each file holds its own set of notes.

tables.name: notes
tables.label: Notes
tables.description: Free-form notes. Each note has a title, a body, an optional date, and a pinned flag.

tables.name: links
tables.label: Links
tables.description: Wiki-link edges parsed from note bodies by the engine: fromId -> toId, one row per [[target]] found in a note's body. toId is the resolved target note id (empty when unresolved); toTitle keeps the raw [[target]] text so a later rename can re-resolve the link.
